title: 對話面試：基礎題庫與上下文追問

steps.text: Tell me about a project or task you worked on.
steps.textYue: 可唔可以講下一個你做過嘅項目或者任務？
steps.followUp: What action did you take, and what was the outcome?
steps.followUpYue: 你當時做咗啲咩？最後有咩成果？

steps.text: What was your specific contribution to that work?
steps.textYue: 喺頭先嗰個項目入面，你自己具體負責邊一部分？
steps.followUp: Which part did you personally own, and how did it help the team?
steps.followUpYue: 邊一部分係你自己做嘅？點樣幫到團隊？

steps.text: Describe a disagreement you helped resolve.
steps.textYue: 講下一次你幫手解決團隊意見分歧嘅經歷。
steps.followUp: What did you say or do, and what changed afterwards?
steps.followUpYue: 你當時講咗啲咩或者做咗啲咩？之後有咩改變？

steps.text: Tell me about a time you had to meet a tight deadline.
steps.textYue: 講下一次你要喺好短時間內趕起工作嘅經歷。
steps.followUp: How did you prioritize your work, and what was the result?
steps.followUpYue: 你點樣安排先後次序？最後趕唔趕得切？

steps.text: What would you do if your first-week results were below expectations?
steps.textYue: 如果返工第一個星期嘅表現未達預期，你會點樣處理？
steps.followUp: What would you do first, and how would you measure success?
steps.followUpYue: 你會先做邊一步？點樣知道自己有改善？
